featured_reviews.name: Danish Husain
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Nightmarish Experience with the HP Spectre 13 purchased from the store.

Regrettably, I'm compelled to award the minimum of 1 star, else, it would be none. My purchase of the HP 13 Spectre, touted as a "premium category" laptop by the salesperson, has proven to be a colossal disappointment.

In early June of this year, I invested in this laptop with the expectation of solid support throughout my MBA program. However, this device has only hindered my academic journey. Less than a month into its use, unsightly blots and marks marred the screen, as visible in the accompanying image. To add insult to injury, the repair process was painful when I went to the store with a valid warranty since it occurred only a month after purchase. There was even mention that charges might be levied for a screen replacement even though it was an internal issue and no external damage had taken place. After persistent requests, it was finally being done for no charges but the screen replacement took an eternity, leaving me laptop-less during crucial coursework affecting my performance but I was helpless.

Now, five months post-replacement, the laptop is a glitch-ridden, unbalanced mess, the hinges also seem unbalanced and it is always slightly tilted. Its touted "premium feature," the 360-degree mode, is a farce since it randomly shuts off when put in tablet mode, I discovered this only today because up till now I was too scared to even bend the laptop thinking the delicate darling would break.

This might just be chalked up to sheer bad luck that I received a faulty piece exacerbated by a late delivery in the first place but never before had I invested such a substantial amount in a laptop, and the regret is palpable.

Purchasing from this store, with its abysmal after-sales service, was a grievous mistake. I hope the luck for others isn't that bad and in hindsight, I should have considered the nearby Vijay Sales.

The prospect of returning to the store for further fixes is met with despair. I've lost hope, as I feel if I go then I'll just have to pay more to fix it and I cannot afford that after such an expensive laptop. It would also come at a loss of further hindrance during my coursework as again ages would be taken to fix it.
An automated reply would be a futile exercise, as my faith in the store's ability to rectify its mistakes has evaporated.

featured_reviews.review_text: Fancy Showroom of almost every electric home appliances. If your budger is on higher side then you should go.

featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Bayadwala
featured_reviews.review_text: We had been buying electronics and home appliances from this shop since a long time. But our recent buy of washing machine turned into a very unfortunate and totally sad story. After sales service of Fairdeal is NOT THERE at all. We are struggling to get our New machine replaced and there is no support at all from them.

featured_reviews.name: A. SAMAD GIRACH
featured_reviews.review_text:
Have been buying things since quite long. I have experienced a friendly staff. though expecting an apple showroom kind of behaviour here is what you shouldn’t expect, rather a desi, friendly & well mannered is what you see.
The price are competitive & delivery is fast. Have never contacted them for after sales so cannot comment on that.
All the best!!

featured_reviews.name: Ambarish V Koundinya
featured_reviews.review_text: Electronic shop in Lohar Chawl, Crawford Market. Pls take cash with you as they don't accept cards.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Pardawala
featured_reviews.review_text:
1. False commitment on delivery
2. Booked a product without inventory. Had to plead for refund after 5 days.
3. Booked 7 products of which one product was damaged and the shop does not accept it.

Post sales the staff behavior turns from bad to worse. Zero customer service.

I would suggest to avoid purchase from this store.

featured_reviews.name: Nilesh
featured_reviews.review_text: You good bargaining skills. The people are friendly but the products were limited. Do your research before going to this place. Its big showroom with small entrance. Shops inside shops under shops. Heavy discounts available but you need bargaining. I found better option on amazon sale else i would have definitely bought fridge and tv from here. They didnt reduce price of fridge further.

featured_reviews.name: Sara Bayadwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Never ever enter this shop, if u don't value ur Money then go ahead and give them the order.... Worst experience and worst staff....

featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: This store deals in electronics, on my recent purchase of a AC the delivery guys before getting the material called me up started asking for extra money to deliver the product. I was promised free delivery of the goods. I was shocked and made a complain to the store manager and the product was finally delivered. Bill was not sent to my address with the Ac and I had to visit the store 2 times to get the bill. We do not expect this type of customer service.
